title: Update on Transition Framework for Carbon Tax
what_it_is: Update on Transition Framework for Carbon Tax

sections.label: Carbon tax transition framework
sections.summary: EDB engages affected chemicals and semiconductor companies on a transition framework with transitory allowances, headline carbon tax on remaining emissions, and Energy Efficiency Fund projects.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Since the announcement, the Economic Development Board (EDB) has been engaging affected companies, such as those in the chemicals and semiconductor sectors, on the details and the implementation of the framework.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The transition framework will be calibrated to spur companies to invest in decarbonisation.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Transitory allowances will be provided only for a proportion – only for a proportion – of the companies' emissions and are based on internationally recognised efficiency benchmarks, where available, or the companies' decarbonisation plans.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The remaining emissions will be subject to the prevailing headline carbon tax.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Government will review and adjust the allowances based on how companies have fared in lowering their emissions, as well as international developments and advancements in decarbonisation technologies.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For the Energy Efficiency Fund, 90 projects amounting to $3.4 million have been approved to date.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Energy Efficiency Fund has been subsumed under the enhanced Energy Efficiency Grant – just two days ago – from 1 April 2024, which will be available to more companies.

sections.label: Number of large sector companies
sections.summary: There are more than 20 large sector companies today and the list will continue to be populated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As to the number of companies, you can imagine, these are large sector companies – today, there are more than 20 companies and the list will continue to be populated.
